author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me. See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each! For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration. My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike. I’m definitely open to seeing different styles though, so please share your work/recs! Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities! For the map, I’d love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel, but I’m pretty open stylistically! It’s a very visual world. Portraits for the time being, but if someone can pin down the perfect art style for the series, it’ll turn to more! Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites on Threads.

title: Need budget-friendly non-AI character art
content: I need character art! I'm a little late to the game and would love any recommendations for budget friendly artists that do not use A.I and have availability now/within the next couple months. #authorthreads #bookthreads Contact: reply on the thread or DM @alliehigdem.author on Threads.

title: Looking for a freelance graphic designer
